snippet.title: From Ruins Cinematic Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4024450/From_Ruins__A_Detective_Adventure

From Ruins is the first game we're developing AND self-publishing, so please help us get the word out if you can. It means the world to us.

From Ruins is a new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

More links: https://lnk.bio/digitalesinteractive
